# checking codons 
```{r}
library(Biostrings)
cds <- readDNAStringSet("~/repositories/mias_intragenomic_variation_mutation_bias/fasta/cleaned_random_500.fasta")
codon_matrix <- DNAStringSet(cds)  # creates a matrix of codons
print(str(codon_matrix))
custom_codon_counts <- table(as.vector(codon_matrix))
print(head(custom_codon_counts))
print(str(custom_codon_counts))
```
